subject: extracting the intercept from mediator model in lavaan

messages.author: 41a97116000e111e
messages.subject: extracting the intercept from mediator model in lavaan
parts:
Hi there!

Question about indirect and direct effect estimation via lavaan. Let's assume the example model from lavaan for a product of coefficient method:

model <- ' # direct effect 
Y ~ c*X 
# mediator 
M ~ a*X Y ~ b*M 
# indirect effect (a*b) ab := a*b 
# total effect 
total := c + (a*b)
 ' 
fit <- sem(model, data = Data)

This would estimate the outcome and mediator model as follows: 

Outcome model: E [Y | a, m] = teta0 + teta1*a + teta2*m
Mediator model: E [M | a] = Beta0 + Beta1*a 

In lavaan teta2 would be b and beta1 a (a*b = indirect effect), teta1 would be c (direct effect).

Is there a way where I can get the value for Beta0 (intercept from the mediator model)?

Thanks so much for your help!
Carlos

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: extracting the intercept from mediator model in lavaan
parts: Is there a way where I can get the value for Beta0 (intercept from the mediator model)?

fit <- sem(model, data = Data, meanstructure = TRUE)

Or this will be switched on automatically if you add at least one intercept parameter to your model syntax (e.g., to label it "beta0")

M ~ beta0*1

You seem to have mixed up the parameter "a" with its associated predictor X.

Outcome model: E [Y | X, M] = teta0 + teta1*X + teta2*M
Mediator model: E [M | X] = Beta0 + Beta1*X
